name: Andrey Makowski
source:
"Andrey is the janitor of the building. Sociable by nature it seems, he is a competent and diligent worker, and on good terms with everyone in the office. Like me, he has family to take care of, so I can relate to him. Does he have the skills to leak the Daikon product? I have no idea."

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dragonfirestudios/netghost/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
